card.description: Students using the OnTrack homework app during one school week. Each student is labeled On Track or Needs Check-in. The app records how many assignments each student submitted in the app, what time they submitted, and how long they spent in the app. A student is labeled On Track when all 5 assignments were submitted in the app before 9 PM. Teachers' gradebook totals were added for comparison.

context.potentialUses: Predict which students need a check-in, so the app can email a parent.

fields.description: An ID for each row of data.
How the student turns in homework.
Assignments the teacher marked as done (out of 5).
Assignments submitted in the app (out of 5).
When the student usually submitted in the app.
Minutes spent in the app this week.
